definitions.explanation: The position the body is in, especially its balance during movement, as in sports, martial arts, falls and lifting. Mostly in {体勢|たいせい}を{崩|くず}す (to lose one's balance) and {体勢|たいせい}を{立|た}て{直|なお}す (to regain it).

examples.japanese: {体勢|たいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}して→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧⟦{転|ころ}んだ→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧。
examples.english: I lost my balance and fell.

examples.japanese: ⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧な{体勢|たいせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{座|すわ}って→座る：00757_suwaru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please sit in a comfortable position.

examples.japanese: ⟦{押|お}された→押す：02854_osu⟧⟦{力士|りきし}→力士：10115_rikishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{土俵際|どひょうぎわ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{体勢|たいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}て{直|なお}し→立て直す：03113_tatenaosu⟧、⟦{逆|ぎゃく}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|な}げた→投げる：01135_nageru⟧。
examples.english: Pushed to the edge of the ring, the wrestler regained his footing and threw his opponent instead.

notes:
⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧ (body) + {勢|せい} (force, momentum).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{態勢|たいせい}→態勢：12937_taisei⟧: readiness, preparedness of a group or system (⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れ→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧⟦{態勢|たいせい}→態勢：12937_taisei⟧, {警戒態勢|けいかいたいせい})
- ⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧: system, regime, establishment
- ⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧: posture as how one holds the body (sitting up straight); also an attitude
- ⟦{構|かま}え→構え：27148_kamae⟧: a ready stance, as in martial arts

WATCH OUT:
The three たいせい words are easy to confuse in writing. {体勢|たいせい} is one body's position; ⟦{態勢|たいせい}→態勢：12937_taisei⟧ is a group being ready for something; ⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧ is how an organization or state is structured.
